blocks.text:
The 2023 17’ x 8’ Lake of the Woods Edition (LOW) is a uniquely premium 17’ sleeper with many upgrades including a noticeably higher ceiling, fireplace, clean open layout, couch that converts to a sofa, and a large 3000 watt generator.  Before you arrive, your house will be warm, powered, and the holes will be drilled.​


​


If you want a premium 17’ house with open space and multiple upgrades, the LOW is the house for you!

Turn key ready

 

 
 8 pre-drilled holes

 

 
 32" Smart TV

 

 
 CD & DVD Play, Stereo

 

 
 Full Kitchenette (microwave, oven, fridge)

 

 
 Rod holders

 

 
 Ice scoop, pliers, scissors, hooks, splitshots*

 

 
 4 Rattle Reels*

 Generator (must purchase gas)

 

 
 Easy parking near the house

 

 
 Close access to Detroit Lakes dining and stores

 

 
 Guide support available if needed

 🎣 Eight holes

Everything is designed to feel premium, spacious, and intentional.
